requestCodes.code:
client = LazopApiClient::Client.new(url, appkey, appSecret)
request = LazopApiClient::Request.new('/jit/purchase_order/batch_pickup_deliver')
request.add_api_parameter("purchaseOrderNoList", "[\"POJ1\",\"POJ2\"]")
request.add_api_parameter("shipperAreaCode", "CN")
request.add_api_parameter("shipperAddressId", "1001")
request.add_api_parameter("shipperAddressDetail", "1 road")
request.add_api_parameter("shipperMobilePhone", "[REDACTED_SAMPLE_PII]")
request.add_api_parameter("shipperName", "test")
request.add_api_parameter("estimatedPickupDate", "2023-10-10")
response = client.execute(request, accessToken)
puts response.success?
puts response.body
